messages:
ana: Quick sync 1 1 Partner AuroraCloud sent their marketplace asset request. Need logo lockups, one-page solution brief, and a co-branded hero image.

mike: Do we have Aurora's vector files? I only see a flattened PNG in the drive.

hao: Partner just shared `aurora-logo-flat.svg` but it uses a neon gradient. They said they can provide a flat version by EOD.

tara: Design constraints: marketplace tile 1:1 1024px, hero 16:9 1400x788, and dark/light backgrounds. Keep partner mark to max 14% width, bottom-left.

sam: Localization: provide EN and FR briefs. FR needs DD/MM/YYYY formatting and accented characters checked. Use Noto Sans fallback for accents.

legal-bot: Legal note: partner requires exact trademark line: "AuroraCloud is a trademark of Aurora Systems." Do not change. Allow 48h for approval.

ana: (typo) I will confirm the trademark glyph with their comms lead and ask for alt text for each image.

mike: Also need accessibility alt text and SVG title/desc. Will run contrast checks for text overlays.

hao: For the solution brief: 1 page, 400

500 words, one architecture callout and a short hardware compatibility note (H100/A100).

tara: I'll mock hero options tonight and attach export names: `aurora_tile_light.png`, `aurora_tile_dark.png`, `aurora_hero_light.jpg`, `aurora_hero_dark.jpg`.

sam: Marketplace summary blurbs: 401 words EN, 401 FR. Also need a 2-sentence technical appendix for the SI.

legal-bot: Reminder: any joint announcement requires a 72h embargo and legal ok. Route final bundle to legal before sending.

ana: Great. If partner flat SVG arrives today we'll assemble and submit for their sign-off by 3pm PT. Any objections?

mike: No objections. Going to start exports once SVG is here.

hao: Forwarding partner flat SVG when received.

ana: Thanks all 1 I'll post the upload link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
